groups.saying_opens: حرم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نبيذ الجر
فقال صدق ابن عمر حرم رسول الله

notes: The gloss يعني ابن حازم is left out
Saying 1: Sa'id asks ibn Umar, who answers: the asked person is the last link (rule 5)
Saying 2: Sa'id goes to ibn Abbas, who answers: a second act with its own last link (rule 4a)
